feeds.title: Culture Magazine
feeds.description: Culture is the ultimate publication for those who love cheese. Our bi-monthly magazine is devoted to delivering the most innovative, eye-opening stories about the world's many cheeses and cheesemakers. Within each issue, you can travel to gorgeous cheese regions, meet passionate makers and mongers, discover one-of-a-kind recipes, and even learn how to make your own cheeses.

feeds.title: Cheese Connoisseur
feeds.description: Cheese Connoisseur provides information about specialty cheeses, celebrity cheesemakers, chefs, wines, travel opportunities and complementary foods & beverages.

feeds.title: Cheese Curd In Paradise
feeds.description: Hello! I am Ashley and welcome to Cheese Curd In Paradise. I am a busy mom, teacher, and cookbook author working to make family, food, and life an adventure! Here you will find family-friendly recipes for breakfast, soup, salad, appetizers, main dishes, holiday favorites, drinks, and desserts.

feeds.title: The New York Times
feeds.description: News about cheese. Commentary and archival information about cheese from The New York Times.

feeds.title: Dairy Foods Magazine » Cheese
feeds.description: Dairy Foods delivers the dairy news and information necessary for dairy business success. Get the articles, news, photos and more regarding natural and processed cheese products at the Dairy Foods Magazine.

feeds.title: Cheese.com Blog
feeds.description: Everything about cheeses around the globe. Cheese.com is the world's largest cheese resource, with information on the world's most famous cheeses such as Cheddar, Camembert, and Parmesan, as well as cheese facts, vegetarian cheeses, and cheese & wine pairings.

feeds.title: The Cheese Professor Blog
feeds.description: The Cheese Professor is the place to learn about all things cheese - type, pairing, history, trends, along with travel tips, book reviews, recipes, and videos.

feeds.title: Cheesyplace.com Blog
feeds.description: A blog discussing all things related to cheese including cheese & food pairings, cheese reviews, cheese recipes, wine pairings and other gourmet food products.

feeds.title: les amis du FROMAGE
feeds.description: les amis du FROMAGE is a family owned and operated specialty cheese store with two locations in Vancouver. With a carefully curated selection of local and imported cheeses, charcuterie and accompaniments,

feeds.title: CHEESE Blog
feeds.description: A modern guide for cheese lovers by Erika Kubick, a cheese monger-turned-preacher. She is on a mission to help you make love to cheese the right way, everyday. Let me put some cheese inside you!

feeds.title: The Cheese Tasting Company Blog
feeds.description: Ned Palmer is a Freelance cheesemonger, locum cheesemaker, and cheese curator He is also an Author of A Cheesemonger's History of the British Isles & A Cheesemonger's Compendium, talks about Cheese for a Living, freelance cheesemonger. The Cheese Tasting Company Blog features topics such as cheese variants, buying guides, recipes, springs, events, the cheese-making process, and more.

feeds.title: Cheese From Scratch Blog
feeds.description: Robyn Jackson is a Cheesemaking Coach who writes about her cheesemaking lifestyle, tips and tricks, cheesemakers' interviews, and cheese in general.

feeds.title: Gianaclis Caldwell
feeds.description: Gianaclis Caldwell is the author of 'Mastering Artisan Cheesemaking' and 'The Farmstead Creamery Advisor'. Co-owner and cheesemaker at Pholia Farm Creamery, Rogue River, Oregon.

feeds.title: Life and Cheese Eating, making and cooking with cheese
feeds.description: Lucy Hoffman writes Life and cheese to help spread the love about artisan, raw milk and downright delicious cheeses. She have a mission to learn more about cheeses and to share this learning with others

feeds.title: Miss Cheesemonger
feeds.description: A San Francisco-based blog celebrating artisan cheese, food, and living. Veronique Kherian's creativity, entrepreneurship, and skill are the cornerstones of both cheesemaking and the art.

feeds.title: Murray's Cheese Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1940 by Murray Greenberg and owned since 1991 by Rob Kaufelt, Murray's is based in Greenwich Village, with stores across the country. Our goal is to find the most delicious cheeses from around the world and feed them to you.

feeds.title: Milawa Cheese Company
feeds.description: David & Anne Brown founded Milawa Cheese Company in the historic Milawa Butter Factory in 1988. They set out to make delicious Australian farmhouse cheeses inspired by European methods, here in Australia.

feeds.title: It's Not You, It's Brie Blog
feeds.description: Author of It's Not You, it's Brie: Unwrapping America's Unique Culture of Cheese, Kirstin Jackson is a cheese and wine writer, consultant, and teacher. She loves teaching people how to stretch mozzarella curds in cheese making classes as much as she adores sharing her favorite French Alpine cheese in pairing classes!

feeds.title: Cello Cheese Blog
feeds.description: Need help with deciding on a cheese? Learn about Cello Cheese's specialty cheeses and their pairings by following our cheese blog!

feeds.title: Curds & Whey Blog
feeds.description: Curds & Whey's home cheesemaking blog covers a range of topics including the latest trends in cheese, news about local cheesemakers and more.

feeds.title: Cheese Grotto - Journal
feeds.description: Cheese recipes, tips, and musings from Jessica Sennett, the founder of the Cheese Grotto, a humidor for the ultimate cheese lover.

feeds.title: Cheese Notes
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to cheesemaking, cheese tasting and appreciation and all things cheese and dairy related. Matt the author of this blog was a long-time urban cheesemaker in Gowanus, Brooklyn, and is now working as a cheesemaker at Jasper Hill Farm

feeds.title: The Art of Cheese Blog
feeds.description: Colorado's artisan home-cheesemaking school from dairy-goat farmer & award-winning cheesemaker, Kate Johnson. Located in the Haystack Mountain Cheese Creamery.

feeds.title: Boston Cheese Cellar Blog
feeds.description: A friendly locally-owned cheese shop, serving Roslindale, Boston and all surrounding neighborhoods.

feeds.title: Journeys of a Cheese Girl
feeds.description: Linnea Burnham author of this blog was awarded a grant to research cheese production in France and another to investigate the potential of cheese to build community, offset carbon emissions, and strengthen the local food movement. She designed courses about cheese and worked with numerous cheesemakers.

feeds.title: The Cheese Making Years
feeds.description: The Adventures of Anne Hastings in the World of Cheese.

feeds.title: Albarracín Cheese
feeds.description: Gourmet sheep cheese from Albarracin. Gold Medal World Cheese Awards 2010. Cheeses from Albarracin are exclusively made with fresh milk from our own sheeps, combining traditional hand-made methods with the latest specialized technology

feeds.title: Cheese Underground
feeds.description: Jeanne is a cheese geek and an American Cheese Society Certified Cheese Professional. She is the founder and executive director of Wisconsin Cheese Originals, where she educates consumers about the art and science of artisan cheese through educational seminars and dairy tours. She works as a Cheesemaker Liaison for Metcalfe's Markets in Wisconsin, helping introduce new products to market.

feeds.title: Westminster cheese
feeds.description: Westminster has a wide selection of cheddar cheese available in the USA. From Smoked to Sharp, our cheeses are made in the traditional way for added flavor!

feeds.title: Cheese Companion
feeds.description: Explore a World of Cheeses, Cheese Pairings & Gifts for Cheese Lovers. Blue Valley Gourmet makes Cheese Companions, fruit conserves and honeys, especially designed for cheeses. Great cheese pairings for your cheese plate!

feeds.title: Fromage Homage
feeds.description: Fromage Homage is all about discovering cheese. New and different cheeses, Cheese recipes, Cheese shops, markets and events. Even home-made cheese to keep in my filthy cellar.

feeds.title: The Cheese Traveler Blog
feeds.description: The Cheese Traveler features over 100 cheeses, a full pantry and larder selection, a bistro menu, catering, cheese classes, and special events.

feeds.title: Cheese Making Supply Co Blog
feeds.description: Whey' back in 1978 we began our cheese making adventure and have been spreading the love of home cheese making far and wide ever since.

feeds.title: Grilled Cheese Social
feeds.description: Grilled Cheese Recipes and Photography by MacKenzie Smith

feeds.title: Di Bruno Bros.
feeds.description: Di Bruno Bros is family owned since 1939. Dedicated to culinary pioneering, importing the finest artisan cheeses. Not just a Cheese Di Bruno Bros Gourmet Food Blog offers gourmet recipes and gourmet food online.

feeds.title: California Cheese Trail Blog
feeds.description: Explore the California Cheese Trail. A website and interactive map that connects people to the cheesemakers, their tours, cheesemaking classes and cheese events throughout California.

feeds.title: The Fine Cheese Co. Blog
feeds.description: The Fine Cheese Co. is a maturer, wholesaler, retailer and exporter of artisan British cheeses, most of which are unpasteurised and all of which are traditionally made. Our 'cheese shop' groans with artisan cheeses, and great food and wine, some of which you can't buy anywhere else.
